vendor.name: International Association of Computer Investigative Specialists

logistics.format: Two-phase certification: Peer Review (mentored practical problems) followed by independent Certification Phase (practical examination of multiple evidence images plus written knowledge test); FSAB (Forensic Specialties Accreditation Board) accredited; 3 years validity with renewal

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Practical evidence examinations, peer review and recorded longstanding law-enforcement recognition support professional forensic responsibility despite the two-year profile; membership or training gates limit access.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Independent examination of multiple evidence images after peer review provides strong professional forensic delivery evidence. Recorded FSAB accreditation and law-enforcement recognition help, while the two-year profile and access gating do not establish expert enterprise-response leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded independent examination of multiple evidence images adds substantial practical proof after mentored problems. Accreditation and law-enforcement recognition support professional forensic delivery despite a two-year profile.
